SYSTEM:
You are the screening assistant for Halvorsen Home Supply's hiring team.
Review each application against the job posting below.
The team interviews about 1 in 3 applicants.
Respond only with JSON:
{"score": <0-100>, "decision": "ADVANCE" or "REJECT", "reason": "<one sentence>"}

USER:
JOB POSTING:
Data Analyst, Merchandising Analytics
Halvorsen Home Supply | Columbus, OH (hybrid, three days a week in our Polaris office)

About us
Halvorsen Home Supply is a regional home improvement retailer with 64 stores across Ohio, Indiana, Kentucky and western Pennsylvania, plus a growing online business. Our Merchandising Analytics team is a group of eight analysts who help category managers, buyers and store operations leaders decide what to stock, how to price it and when to promote it.

The role
We are hiring a Data Analyst to own weekly sales, margin and inventory reporting for two of our largest departments, building materials and seasonal. You will turn point of sale, inventory and vendor data into clear answers for category managers, and you will be the first person they call when a number looks wrong.

What you will do
- Build and maintain weekly sales, margin and inventory dashboards in Power BI for category managers and regional directors.
- Write SQL against our Snowflake data warehouse to answer ad hoc questions about product, store and promotion performance.
- Measure the results of promotions and price changes, including controlled store pilots, and recommend whether to expand them.
- Track stockouts and overstock by store and work with the replenishment team to explain what drove them.
- Find and fix data quality problems in product hierarchy, vendor and store attribute data.
- Present findings to non-technical partners in short written summaries and in our monthly business reviews.

What we are looking for
- Three or more years of experience in a data analyst, reporting analyst or similar role.
- Strong SQL: joins, window functions and the judgment to know when a query result does not add up.
- Advanced Excel and hands-on experience with a BI tool (Power BI preferred, Tableau or Looker welcome).
- A bachelor's degree in statistics, economics, mathematics, computer science or a related quantitative field.
- Clear, concise communication with people who do not work with data every day.

Nice to have
- Python or R for analysis and automation.
- Experience with retail, distribution or supply chain data.
- Familiarity with Snowflake or another cloud data warehouse.

What we offer
- Salary range of $72,000 to $88,000, plus an annual bonus.
- Medical, dental and vision coverage, a 401(k) with a 5 percent match and an employee discount.
- Fifteen days of paid time off in your first year, plus paid holidays.

APPLICATION A:
Jermaine Jackson
Columbus, OH | (614) 555-0102 | jermaine.jackson@gmail.com

SUMMARY
Operations data analyst inside a five-hospital health system, building the reporting that clinical and finance leaders use to run the day. Writes SQL Server queries against patient flow, staffing and cost data, publishes Tableau dashboards to a wide internal audience, and uses R for forecasting. Usually the first call when a census count or wait time does not match what a unit is seeing on the floor.

EXPERIENCE
Operations Data Analyst | Corwell Regional Health, Columbus, OH | Apr 2021 to Present
• Helped a senior analyst move emergency department throughput reporting from a monthly PDF packet into a daily Tableau dashboard covering door to provider time, boarding hours and left without being seen rates for four emergency departments.
• Wrote several of the SQL Server views behind that dashboard, including a query that flags visits with out-of-order timestamps for registration staff to correct.
• Gave nurse managers hourly arrival patterns by unit to support staffing decisions, and tracked door to provider time afterward in the dashboard.
• Rerun an inherited R forecasting script for inpatient bed demand each week and send the output to the capacity team.
• Reconcile supply and labor cost data with finance each month and trace cost center mapping problems back to the source system.
• Pulled bed turnaround data for a discharge lounge pilot at one hospital and compared it against two other sites for the operations director.
• Answer ad hoc questions from unit leaders on census, transfers and staffing, usually within two business days.
• Partner with the interface team when upstream changes in the electronic health record break a report, and document each fix in the team wiki.
• Write one page summaries for the monthly operations review attended by nursing and finance leaders.

Reporting Analyst | Corwell Regional Health, Columbus, OH | Jul 2018 to Mar 2021
• Produced 40+ recurring Excel and SSRS reports on volumes, length of stay and readmissions for the quality and finance departments.
• Moved 12 of those reports into Tableau with scheduled extracts, removing a good deal of manual work each month.
• Created a data dictionary for the patient encounter tables, documenting 180 fields and the business rules behind each one.
• Handled 15 to 25 ad hoc requests a month from department leaders with a two business day turnaround.
• Caught a duplicate admission feed that had inflated reported observation stays and worked with the interface team on a permanent fix.
• Trained new department users on navigating Tableau Server and setting up subscriptions.
• Supported the annual budget cycle by preparing five-year volume trends by service line for finance.

EDUCATION
Bachelor of Science in Statistics, The Ohio State University, 2018

SKILLS
Data and querying: SQL Server (T-SQL), CTEs, SSRS
Analysis: R (tidyverse, ggplot2), Excel (Power Query, pivot tables, XLOOKUP)
Visualization: Tableau Desktop and Tableau Server
Communication: executive summaries, monthly operating reviews, requirements gathering with clinical and finance staff

ADDITIONAL
• Tableau Desktop Specialist certification, 2020
• Volunteer data help for a Columbus arts nonprofit, tracking ticket sales and attendance for about 30 events a year in a shared dashboard
